 Follow us on Facebook Twitter Hello Latest news Across the U.S. this week, some Social Security beneficiaries are to receive their monthly payment for November 2026.
 Getty Images Social Security Social Security benefits are being sent out tomorrow, Wednesday, Nov. 18: who gets a payment?
 William Allen Greg Heilman Update: Nov 17th, 2026 10:15 EST 0 Share facebook twitter whatsapp Make us preferred on Google In the U.S., certain Social Security recipients are to get their November benefits tomorrow , as the Social Security Administration (SSA) continues the program’s three-Wednesdays cycle for this month .
 Who gets Social Security benefits on Wednesday, Nov. 18?
 Each month, most of the Social Security scheme’s 71.7 million beneficiaries are paid on the second, third or fourth Wednesday . Under this system, a recipient’s designated payment date is decided by their birthday.
 As tomorrow is the third Wednesday in November, it’s a date that will see benefits sent out to recipients who were born between the 11th and 20th of any month .
 This week’s payment run comes after a slightly ahead-of-schedule start to this month’s three-Wednesdays cycle. Because the second Wednesday in November was the Veterans Day holiday, beneficiaries born from the first to the 10th of any month received their payment a day earlier than usual, on Tuesday 10 .
 November’s full three-Wednesdays cycle is:
 Born on 1st-10th of any month: Tuesday, Nov. 10 
 Born on 11th-20th of any month: Wednesday, Nov. 18 
 Born on 21st-31st of any month: Wednesday, Nov. 25 
 NB: If you claim Social Security based on someone else’s work record, the SSA uses the other person’s birthday to determine your allocated payment Wednesday.
 What other Social Security payment runs are there in November 2026?
 Tomorrow is the third of four Social Security payment runs on this month’s schedule. Before the three-Wednesdays cycle kicked in, the SSA sent out benefits to two groups of recipients whose monthly distribution date is not birthday-dependent:
 Nov. 3: Social Security paid to dual recipients and some long-term beneficiaries 
 On Tuesday 3 , November’s Social Security benefits were sent out to individuals who began receiving their monthly payments before May 1997 . Tuesday 3 was also this month’s Social Security payment date for beneficiaries who simultaneously receive Supplemental Security Income (SSI).
 A needs-based benefit for certain low-income, low-resource Americans , SSI is separate to the Social Security program , despite also being run by the SSA.
 Unlike Social Security, applicants to the SSI scheme do not need to earn employment credits to be eligible for monthly benefits. Worth an average of $740.07 per month, SSI was issued for November on Friday, October 30 . 
 Social Security benefits - average monthly amounts:
 Retirement: $2,037.84 
 Disability: $1,500.84 
 Survivor: $1,636.75 
 Source: The SSA’s ‘ monthly statistical snapshot ’, released in Nov. 2026.
 How much is the 2027 COLA?
 In a bid to protect beneficiaries’ purchasing power, the SSA has announced that it is to raise Social Security and SSI amounts by 3.6% in 2027 . 
 Across all Social Security beneficiaries, this translates into an increase of about $70 on the current average payment , which stands at $1,946.23 per month.
 How does the Social Security Admin make payments?
 Direct deposit 
 Social Security beneficiaries can provide the SSA with their bank details by using the online “ my Social Security ” tool.
 Direct Express 
 Benefits can be paid onto the Direct Express Card , a special debit card for recipients who do not have a bank account. Sign up for Direct Express at 1-800-333-1795 or 1-800-772-1213, or at a Social Security office.
